why.title: Why book flights with Hotel Jr
why.heading: Trips that suit you
why.body: Booking a flight should be the exciting part of a trip, not the stressful one. With so much to compare, finding the right fare can take hours. Hotel Jr brings it together so you can search routes, compare prices and dates, and see the full cost before you book. Add a hotel to the same trip, keep your plans in one place, and spend your time looking forward to the journey instead.

items.question: Fly during the working week
items.answer: Tuesdays and Wednesdays are often cheaper than weekends, when demand from leisure travelers is highest.

items.question: Book early
items.answer: Fares tend to rise as seats fill up, so booking a few weeks ahead usually beats waiting until the last minute.

items.question: Consider less popular departure times
items.answer: Early morning and late evening flights are often priced lower than those in the middle of the day.

items.question: Choose flights with a connection
items.answer: A stopover can cost less than a nonstop flight. Check that the layover is long enough to make your connection.

items.question: Stay flexible with your dates
items.answer: Moving your trip by a day or two can change the fare, so compare nearby dates before you book.

items.question: Book a flight and hotel together
items.answer: Package deals can cost less than booking each one separately, especially for longer stays.

items.question: Watch out for hidden costs
items.answer: Check what is included in the fare, such as baggage and seat selection, so you can compare the real price.

items.question: What do I need to bring to pick up the car?
items.answer: Usually a valid driving license, a passport or ID, and a card in the main driver's name. Check your rental details, as this varies by supplier and country.

items.question: Do I need to pay a deposit?
items.answer: Most suppliers hold a deposit on a card at pick-up and release it after you return the car in good condition.

items.question: Is there a minimum driver age?
items.answer: This depends on the supplier and country. Drivers under 25 or over 69 may pay an extra fee.

items.question: How does fuel work?
items.answer: Many rentals are full to full, which means you collect the car with a full tank and return it full.

items.question: Can I cancel my booking?
items.answer: Cars marked as free cancellation can be cancelled for free until the time shown. Other rentals follow the supplier's rules.

items.question: How do I get my ticket?
items.answer: Your booking confirmation includes your reference. Check the rules for your operator, as some journeys need a printed or station-collected ticket.

items.question: How early should I arrive?
items.answer: Around 20 minutes is usually enough, but allow more time for international trains with passport checks.

items.question: How much luggage can I bring?
items.answer: Most trains are generous with luggage, but limits vary by operator. Check before you travel.

items.question: Can I change my ticket?
items.answer: Refundable tickets can usually be changed or cancelled before departure. Other tickets follow the operator's rules.

items.question: Do children need a ticket?
items.answer: Rules vary by country and operator. Children aged 2 to 15 pay a child fare on this site.

items.question: What is included in a package?
items.answer: A round-trip flight for everyone in your group and a hotel stay between your flight dates.

items.question: How does the discount work?
items.answer: You get 6% off the combined price of the flight and the hotel. The package price is shown before you book.

items.question: Will I be charged when I book?
items.answer: Online payment is not connected yet, so you will not be charged and no card details are needed.

items.question: Can I stay for different dates than my flights?
items.answer: Not yet. Your check-in date is your departure date, and your check-out date is your return date.

legal-terms.title: Booking terms
legal-terms.summary: The rules that apply when you use Hotel Jr and book a stay, flight or activity.

sections.title: About these terms
paragraphs: Hotel Jr is operated by [Company legal name], registered in [Country] at [Registered address]. In these terms, "we" means [Company legal name] and "you" means the person using the site.
By using the site or making a booking, you agree to these terms. If you book for other people, you confirm that you have their permission and that they accept these terms too.

sections.title: Our role
paragraphs: We help you find and book travel services provided by others, such as hotels, airlines and activity operators. The provider of each service is responsible for delivering it, and its own conditions also apply to your booking.

sections.title: Making a booking
paragraphs: A booking is only confirmed when you receive a booking reference from us.
items: You must be at least 18 years old to make a booking.
The details you give must be accurate. Names on flight bookings must match each traveler's passport.
Prices and availability can change until your booking is confirmed.

sections.title: Prices and payment
paragraphs: Prices are shown in the currency displayed at checkout and include the taxes and fees we are told about, unless we say otherwise. Hotels may charge local taxes or deposits at the property.
Each booking shows how and when you pay. Some hotel bookings are paid at the property.

sections.title: Changes and cancellations
paragraphs: The cancellation rules for your booking are shown before you confirm it. Where a booking is marked as free cancellation, you can cancel for free until the time stated. Non-refundable bookings cannot be refunded unless the law requires it.
If a provider changes or cancels your booking, we will tell you as soon as we can and help you with your options.

sections.title: Your responsibilities when traveling
paragraphs: You are responsible for having everything you need for your trip.
items: Valid passports, visas and any required vaccinations.
Arriving on time for check-in, departures and activities.
Following the rules of the hotel, airline or activity operator.

sections.title: Our responsibility to you
paragraphs: We take care to show accurate information, but much of it comes from providers. Nothing in these terms limits any rights you have by law that cannot be limited. [Liability wording to be added by your lawyer.]

sections.title: Governing law and contact
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of [Country]. If you have a problem with a booking, contact us at [Support email] and we will try to put it right.
We may update these terms. The version that applies is the one shown when you made your booking.

legal-privacy.title: Privacy statement
legal-privacy.summary: What personal information we collect, why we use it and the choices you have.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Hotel Jr is operated by [Company legal name], [Registered address]. We are responsible for your personal information. You can contact us about privacy at [Privacy email].

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect the information you give us when you use the site.
items: Account details: your name, email address and password.
Booking details: names, email, phone number, travel dates, and any arrival time or special requests.
Flight bookings: the name and date of birth of each traveler, including children.
Car rentals: the main driver's name and date of birth, to check the driver's age.
Searches you make, such as destinations and dates.

sections.title: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use your information only for these purposes.
items: To make and manage your bookings.
To sign you in and keep your account secure.
To contact you about your trip and answer your questions.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We share your booking details with the hotel, airline or activity operator providing your service, because they need them to deliver it. We also use service providers that help us run the site: [List of hosting, email and payment providers].
We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Payments
paragraphs: We do not store card numbers. When online payment is added, card details will be handled directly by [Payment provider].

sections.title: Cookies and third-party content
paragraphs: We use one essential cookie named "session" to keep you signed in. It lasts for 7 days and cannot be read by scripts on the page.
Photos on the site load directly from Unsplash, so Unsplash receives your IP address and basic browser information when you view them. We do not currently use advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep booking records for [Retention period] to meet accounting and legal requirements. Account details are kept until you ask us to delete your account.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:
items: See the personal information we hold about you.
Ask us to delete your information.
Object to how we use it, or complain to your data protection authority.

sections.title: Changes to this statement
paragraphs: We may update this statement. We will change the date at the top when we do.
